text:
Aria (Community): Heads-up: we've released redwood-connector-kit v0.4.0 and we're running a Community Integrations Hack Night next Thurs 7pm PT. RSVP + demo signups: https://events.redwood.ai/hacknight (demo slots limited). Please RT to maintainers and folks who build adapters. :sparkles:

Kai (Engineering): Sweet. Is v0.4.0 a minor bump? Any migration work?

Aria (Community): Non-breaking. Main callouts below, copy/paste-friendly for READMEs.

```
redwood-connector-kit v0.4.0
- new: WebSocket streaming adapter (low-latency dev flow)
- new: pluggable rate-limiter hooks (token-bucket + leaky-bucket)
- perf: reduced Docker image by ~18% (multi-stage build)
- test: expanded E2E matrix with Dedicated + Private smoke tests
- fix: auth refresh edge-case when using KMS-wrapped keys
```

Priya (Maintainer): Can we get a tiny npm/pnpm install snippet and a Private example for the docs? I'll prep the release note PR Friday.

Marta (Docs): I'll draft the quickstart and migration note. Snippets to include:

```bash
# install
npm install @redwood/connector-kit@0.4.0
# or
pnpm add @redwood/connector-kit@0.4.0
```

```yaml
# private deployment example
connector:
  adapter: websocket
  auth:
    type: kms
    key_alias: "projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/rdw"
  rate_limiter:
    strategy: token_bucket
    capacity: 1000
    refill_per_sec: 50
```

Nikhil (DevRel): For Hack Night I'm reserving 4 demo slots (10min + 5min Q&A). Maintainers can sign up on the event page. I'll also blast a short thread on the community forum + post a banner in the docs. Can we get a hero screenshot or a short gif demonstrating WebSocket streaming?

Priya (Maintainer): I can record a 30s gif showing the streaming adapter and a small perf note (p95 ~ 120ms on Dedicated-2x).

Aria (Community): Amazing. Also scheduling a maintainer office hour Wed 11am PT to help anyone with release notes, demo prep, or back-compat checks.

release-bot: Automated release: redwood-connector-kit v0.4.0 published by @aria. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-connector-kit/compare/v0.3.2...v0.4.0. CI status: all green. :robot_face:

Kai (Engineering): One ask: if demos hit the Private flow, please include the sample config and note any special network setup (VPC peering or proxy). Ops can provide a screenshot of the Dedicated dashboard if needed.

Nikhil (DevRel): Copy that. I'll add a demo template to the event doc with placeholders for "deployment type", "p95", "tokens/sec", and "screenshot/gif link".

Aria (Community): Thanks everyone! If maintainers want a tweet copy or a short blurb for the repo, drop it here or DM me. Looking forward to seeing demos at Hack Night :rocket:
